screening_role: exploratory positive case selection; unchanged full benchmark
top20_definition: ceil(0.2*n) residues, descending values; stable tie order
hchi_correction: subtract amino-acid mean from the other four training folds from both prediction and MD
dual_phenotype_definition: within-chain lower half RMSF and top quarter type-corrected Hchi; omit five residues at each terminus
analysis_scope: stored MD targets and existing predictions; no new inference, trajectories or wet-lab validation
